nodes.text: BUILD Profile, Connection, Operation, Map, Process. The working copy, saved in your cloud account.
TEST MODE Press Test on a runtime. Open each shape and see the document going in and out. Build-time only.
PACKAGE Packaged Component, version 1.0.0 plus notes. A rollback point. Boomi answer to the BW EAR file.
DEPLOY Send the package to an Environment. Deploy never runs anything by itself.
2 ENVIRONMENT - the target of a deployment (Extensions hold per-stage values) DEV TEST PROD sample data, free to break integration and UAT, own hosts real data, controlled release
One run = one Execution. It handles a SET of documents. A record is only a row inside a document.
Fix it in Build, create package 1.0.1, deploy again. The loop starts again at step 1. Retention is limited, so capture evidence early.
SAY IT IN ONE BREATH Design in the cloud, run on the runtime, push documents through shapes, package to deploy, extensions per environment, Process Reporting to troubleshoot.
BEAT 1: Where you design Browser Build tab, not the BW Designer desktop tool.
BEAT 2: How data moves Documents through shapes, not process data variables.
BEAT 3: How you release Package and deploy, not an EAR file.
Then name one thing with no BW equivalent, for example Document Tracking or Atom Cloud.
customers.csv on disk Sits in C:\boomi\in on the machine where the Atom runs. A cloud runtime cannot see this folder.
Disk Get Connector = Disk. Operation = Get, directory, filter customers*.csv, response profile CustomerCSV.
ONE DOCUMENT Payload: whole CSV text (3 records). Metadata: file name, directory. One file = one document.
Disk Send Operation = Send, directory C:\boomi\out, file name from src_name plus .json.
Map CustomerCSV to CustomerJSON. Four field links, trim and lower-case email, default city Unknown.
Set Properties Copy the Disk file name into DDP src_name. It travels with this document only.
Stop Path ends. Status Complete means the paths finished, not that every record was good.
Process Reporting Find the execution, open the document view: 1 doc in, 1 doc out. Confirm the file exists.
Break the input Remove a column, add a comma, send an empty file. Read the error and explain it.
IN: 1 document, 3 records (after Disk Get) customer_id,customer_name,email,city 101,Rahul,rahul@example.com,Hyderabad 102,Amit,amit@example.com,Bangalore 103,Sneha,sneha@example.com,Chennai

OUT: 1 document, array of 3 objects (after Map) [ {"customer_id":"101","customer_name":"Rahul", "email":"rahul@example.com","city":"Hyderabad"}, {"customer_id":"102", ... Amit ... }, {"customer_id":"103", ... Sneha ... } ]
The document envelope Payload = the data (CSV text or JSON body). Metadata = properties about this one document, such as file name and DDPs.
Where values live DDP = per document, travels with it. DPP = per run, shared by all documents. Process Property = persisted. Extension = per environment.
TRAP: document is not record Do not add Split Documents here. You would get 3 object documents, not 1 array.
TRAP: Number drops quotes customer_id as Number gives 101, not "101". Keep Character.
TRAP: DDP can vanish Get, Split and Combine create new documents. Re-set the DDP after them.
Use when the target accepts the whole file or array. Fewest moving parts, so the easiest to explain and to test.
Use when you need lookups, validation or branching per record, then a single array at the end. Combine needs a matching profile.
Use when the target API takes one record per request. Remember: three sends, so make the target safe to repeat (idempotent).
DECISION = conditional split True: reject Decision docs in email empty? False: send Each document goes down ONE path, True or False, based on a comparison. Think: if / else.
BRANCH = fan-out in order Path 1 runs first docs in Branch Path 2 runs next The SAME documents go down every numbered path, one path after another. Path 1 finishes before path 2 starts.
